description: This file defines a class named HTMLPurifier_URIFilter_DisableResources that extends HTMLPurifier_URIFilter. The class is responsible for filtering URLs to disable resources based on embedded URI context.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_URIFilter_DisableResources
classes.description: A filter class that disables resource URLs if they are embedded within certain contexts.

methods.name: filter
methods.description: Filters the given URI based on whether it is embedded or not, returning false to disable resources when embedded.
